topics.name: Runtime Active Snapshot
topics.purpose: Define the exact accepted canonical snapshot currently loaded by a runtime instance, independently from the repository's newest accepted or candidate state.

semantics.binding_rule: Each running instance records the exact accepted snapshot identity it has loaded.
semantics.separation_rule: Repository current accepted snapshot and runtime active snapshot may temporarily differ.
semantics.candidate_rule: Candidate/review snapshots cannot become runtime active without acceptance plus explicit activation.
semantics.identity_rule: Runtime instance identity and active snapshot identity are distinct.
semantics.evidence_rule: Active binding retains load/activation timestamp, result and snapshot refs.
semantics.authority_rule: Being active does not alter semantic ownership or AccessCore policy.

invariants.rule: Repository acceptance establishes canonical source state; runtime activation/reload is a separate explicit lifecycle operation over an exact accepted snapshot.
